verdict.rationale: Conductor's entire interaction model is natural-language chat with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) that can autonomously test, build, and edit without step confirmation, and it exposes a hosted MCP server so ChatGPT/Claude/Codex or other AI clients can manage workspaces via natural language, plus an API to send prompts and read agent replies. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of natural-language command reliability beyond vendor docs.
